items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: It was Smalley and Jewel's band.

ctx.x: How did you get that band together? How did you get that band together?

Well, that's kind of a mystery. Let me see, I was playing up at Seven and Howard. And it's, uh, Smiley and Joe. Now, I can't think of his trumpet player's name. But he's out in California. I don't know. Anyway, that's where I was playing. Ridgely's brother was managing the Pelican Garden. And he was in there one night. And he heard me playing. And he called me off to stand. I went to his table. We had a couple of drinks. And he asked me, he said, Andy, why don't you get up a band and come play for me? I said,…
How many pieces you said it was?
